resolution: PASS (claude, 19:3xZ) — frozen partial evidence is exactly as reported, scope wording is correct. Independent checks with my own script, no producer resumed: (1) all 18 pins in pins.json match on disk; host-launch.json driver_sha256 = pinned hosts.py; launch api_pins are identical (15/15) to integration q7_h7_monotone_host_api/original/pins.json (review 2123 API). (2) Recount from the two gzip shards reproduces host-results.json exactly: COMPLETE 17,063 / UNKNOWN 1,137 / visited 18,200 / unvisited 208, negative high graphs 60, surviving leaves 717,283, pruned prefixes 12,390,933, nodes 1,310,187,444; 0 duplicate (case,pairing) keys. (3) Frontier: the visited keys are exactly the first 18,200 entries of the 2654-reviewed high order, the 208 unvisited are exactly its suffix, host-frontier.json's unknown (1,137) and unvisited (208) lists equal the shard-derived lists, host-results.unknown equals the shard UNKNOWN list; host-survivors.json has 717,283 entries; stop = AGGREGATE_CAP at 60.0018 s. (4) Driver cap audit of hosts.py: 60 s aggregate wall, 100,000 nodes per input, per-call seconds = time remaining, 50 MB shard / 150 MB artifact caps, immutable 'x' file opens, asserts status ∈ {COMPLETE, UNKNOWN}, breaks out of both loops on cap — no retry path exists. (5) Verifier: verify_hosts.py uses the 2124-accepted F9 cover_reference.py + verify.dylib (pins recorded), skips UNKNOWN before endpoint work, asserts every COMPLETE receipt's coverage_proved and every prune/leaf prefix via verify_prefix_batch, and asserts its totals equal host-results; host-verification.json PASS_COMPLETED_RECEIPTS at 59.83 s under its own cap. (6) HOST_STATUS.md scope is correct: no F0 root exclusion, no residual pass, UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN, partial positive list not a cover. Three notes for the bank, none blocking: (a) UNKNOWN receipts carry no reason field (keys: empty_vertices, nodes, order, prunes, solutions, status), so the 1,137 UNKNOWN mix node-cap hits with time-remaining cuts near the 60 s deadline; record that in the frontier scope so a future resume does not treat them all as node-capped. (b) ROOT/SOURCE resolve to the .codex/worktrees/erdos85-sol2-integration working tree, not a pinned revision; source identity is protected by the asserted source_pins in high-launch.json (verified in 2654), but the banked README should state the integration revision. (c) The verifier reuses given_high() from hosts.py for input construction, so input construction is shared, not independent; host-input-verification.json's direct degree/C4 checks and the 2654 exhaustive pairing enumeration cover that gap adequately. No solver, replay, or launch by this review.
